meta.title: Inventor HSM / Inventor CAM Complete Parameter Catalog
meta.description: Comprehensive catalog of ALL Inventor HSM / InventorCAM operations, parameters, and API surfaces for PRISM integration
sources: dump.cps diagnostic post (reveals all toolpath parameters)

adaptive_2d.description: High-efficiency constant engagement clearing with helix ramping

optimalLoad.description: Target engagement as % of tool diameter

orderByDepth.description: Complete each depth before moving deeper

contour_2d.description: Profile machining of 2D contours with compensation support

pocket_2d.description: Traditional offset pocket clearing with multiple pattern options

face_2d.description: Top face surfacing with adjustable patterns

slot_2d.description: Dedicated slot milling with trochoidal motion

trace_2d.description: Follow 2D/3D curves for engraving or tracing

engrave_2d.description: Engraving text and logos with V-bits or ball mills

circular_2d.description: Circular pocket milling for large holes

adaptive_3d.description: 3D adaptive clearing with constant engagement on complex surfaces

parallel_3d.description: Constant Z parallel passes for finishing

pencil_3d.description: Rest machining in corners and fillets

steep_shallow_3d.description: Combined strategy for complex surfaces - contour on steep, parallel on shallow

swarf_5axis.description: Side milling with tilting tool axis along ruled surfaces

flow_5axis.description: UV-based machining following surface flow lines

profile_roughing.description: OD/ID roughing with multiple depth cuts

profile_finishing.description: OD/ID finish turning with spring passes

drilling_turning.description: Center drilling and axial drilling on lathe

probe_surface.description: Probe surface point or Z height

probe_work_offset.description: Establish work coordinate system from probing
